name: humid_air_1691_whf_ceiling_window_open_paused
description: Humid night (outdoor dew point ~67F, at or above the 65F ceiling): opening a window does not start the whole-house fan; HVAC pauses for the open window
notes: Dew points (feels_like.dew_point_f): indoor 76.0F at 50.0% = 56.01F; outdoor 70.0F at 90.2% = 66.99F. Ceiling = default 65F (option On).

Three-exercise protocol (CLAUDE.md Sec 10): (a) effectiveness: deleting the third guard in decide_nat_vent_start_veto makes 20:10 read natural_ventilation and the fan start. (b) docs-production: docs/08-COMPUTATION-REFERENCE.md 'Humid-air guard (Issue #1691)' states this rule and production applies it through humidity_facts.humid_air_verdict. (c) occupant: without the guard the fan pulls 67F-dew-point air into a 56F-dew-point house all night; the house turns sticky.

verdict.summary: Humid night (outdoor dew point ~67F, at or above the 65F ceiling): opening a window does not start the whole-house fan; HVAC pauses for the open window

events.note: Summer evening, windows closed: outdoor cooler than the house, so free cooling is on offer by temperature.
Hot day, cool mode: with the windows closed the AC holds the band (no fan starts in a sealed house).
Five minutes later, same air: the engine re-asks the start question (paused-reactivation / idle-open re-check).
